correctness.rationale: For all positive C1 profiles the finite covariance identity follows from the exact Laguerre expansion of Gaussian logarithms. Bounded coefficient variation yields a uniform (1+|x|)^-2 dilogarithm majorant and permits locally uniform dominated convergence. The log-Laplace transform has strictly positive second derivative, proving strict fixed-midpoint radial decay. Two endpoint Laplace estimates, a uniform small-q dilogarithm expansion and Plancherel give the positive sharp d^2 exp(-2d) coefficient. The executed standalone checker reported 34 passing numerical checks on three distinct positive affine profiles; numerical evidence is supplementary to the proof.

The full profile kernel, strict fixed-midpoint decorrelation, and sharp endpoint/bulk coefficient give quantitative information for comparing circle measurements across a broad open set of variance profiles, rather than a numerical or arbitrary-parameter refinement.
